# System Design Canvas

> A browser canvas for thinking about, planning and drawing software architecture. No account, no backend: designs stay in the browser's localStorage. The app calls no AI model.

## For AI assistants

- [Design format](https://system-design-canvas.ozersubasi-dev.workers.dev/llms-full.txt): the `sdc/design@1` JSON format. A user copies a prompt from "Edit with AI" on a canvas, and pastes your answer back; the app checks it, shows what would change, and applies it after they confirm.

## Pages

- [Home](https://system-design-canvas.ozersubasi-dev.workers.dev/): what the tool does
- [Projects](https://system-design-canvas.ozersubasi-dev.workers.dev/projects): the user's designs and the starting templates
